text: Mein Leben ist besser!!!!
author: Havin Askin
developer_reply: Havin, you have no idea how happy your review made me! Knowing that something we created is making a real difference in your life is such an incredible feeling. This is exactly what keeps us going, even on the toughest days. Thank you for making our day with these few words! Martyna, co-founder of Unique

text: Leider kann man die Sprache nicht ändern (würde die App gerne auf Deutsch nutzen) - ansonsten sehr gut, bloß sind die Routinen immer mit der Stoppuhr zu erledigen, obwohl ich die Aktivitäten gerne einfach bestätigen würde, wäre toll, wenn man das einstellen könnte.
author: M.M.D.
developer_reply: Thank you for your thoughtful feedback! We're happy to hear you're enjoying Unique overall. Your suggestions about adding German and making routines easier to complete without the stopwatch are very valuable, and we'll take them into consideration. If your experience improves in the future, we'd truly appreciate an updated rating.

text: For me the most interesting feature of the app is the Meditation Generator. And I really want to Like the App more - Just for providing this tool. (And I might Adjust my Rating in the future.) But: The To-Do-System offers little more than other Apps and the Tools and Lessons gave me nearly nothing new. I will use the Meditation a few more Times, though the voice - for me - could be a little softer, slower and less robotic. But I paid for a year and will See where this goes. :)
author: Leon Lichterigel
developer_reply: Thanks for your thoughtful feedback, Leon, and for giving Unique a chance. We're really glad you're enjoying the AI Meditation Generator. Your comments about the voice, lessons, and planner are very valuable and help guide our improvements. We hope you'll enjoy future updates, and if your experience improves, we'd truly appreciate an updated rating

text: Leider viel zu viele Paywalls. Die App hat an sich viel Potential aber so ist sie keineswegs toll. Ich kann mir nicht vorstellen, dass Leuten mit ADHS damit geholfen ist. Aus meinem Umfeld kann ich das gut beobachten. Am Anfang fühlt sich die App toll an, aber nachdem nach und nach mehr Paywalls eingebaut werden ist das immer schlimmer. zum Glück gibt es ja andere Methoden als diese App.
author: Matthias
developer_reply: Thank you for your honest feedback. We’re sorry the app felt this way. Just to clarify, Unique does not have ads — we use a subscription model so we can keep improving the app. We also offer many features for free. If you still see value in Unique, we’d be grateful if you considered updating your rating.

text: Transparenz über die unterstützten Sprachen schon vor der Installation oder direkt beim ersten Öffnen ist wichtig, um Enttäuschungen zu vermeiden. Ich war enttäuscht, denn ich verschwendete wertvolle Zeit dies rauszufinden. Ich komme gerne wieder, wenn es die App in Deutsch zur Verfügung steht. Dann gibt es den fehlenden Stern. Vielen Dank für ihre schnelle Mitteilung.
author: Catrin Neumann
developer_reply: Hi Catrin, thanks for trying Unique. Right now the app is English-only, but we plan to add German in the next few months. If you want to remove it, close the app, long-press the app icon, then tap Delete/Uninstall. If you keep it, please consider updating to 5 stars to help other ADHDers discover Unique. You can write us at: contact@univi.app

text: AI "art" used and an subscription plan. If you need to charge your users for your app (which is/would be fair on its own) but you can at least support real artists or at the very least use stock images
author: Calypso
developer_reply: Thanks for your feedback, Calypso. We use some AI visuals to keep Univi affordable, but all videos are created by talented artists who bring real care and authenticity to the stories. We truly appreciate your perspective and hope you’ll give the app another chance — Martyna, co-founder of Unique

text: An excellent tracker app for ADHD, as well as a great and fast customer support! When one of my repeating tasks duplicated, it was fixed very fast by the developer Mateusz :) Definitely 5 stars from me!
author: Ve e
developer_reply: Thank you so much! Your message truly made our day. I’m really happy to hear that Unique helps you stay on track and that our support could sort things out quickly. We put a lot of heart into both the app and the ADHD people using it. Thanks for your trust and the 5 stars. It means a lot! — Martyna, co-founder of Unique

text: The App ist great.👍 Since the Last Update, it doesn't save my reflection correctly. I hope you can fix it fast because for us ADHS people it's frustrating doing things twice for no effort 😉
author: Charlotte Schönfelder
developer_reply: Thanks Charlotte! We weren't aware of this issue, but we’ll take a closer look right away. Thank you for pointing it out. If you still enjoy using Univi, I’d be so grateful if you could update your review to 5 stars. Good reviews are extremely helpful for our small team grow. I am always available via contact@univi.app. Martyna, co-founder of Univi

text: Tolle App. Das einzige Problem, dass ich hatte, war dass die Aufgaben nicht verschwinden, wenn ich sie lösche - auch mit Änderungen bei den Aufgaben tut sich der mitgelieferte Aufgabenplanner sehr schwer. Das ist sehr nervig! Außerdem muss man immer den Timer mitlaufen lassen und kann nicht einfach nur hinterher sagen, wie lange es gedauert hatte. Hinzu kommt, dass es sehr leichte und wenige Lerninhalte sind. Hätte mir noch viel mehr Input gewünscht. Doch die Tipps, die man bekommt sind gut.
author: Joelle Eichmüller
developer_reply:
Hey Joelle,

Thanks for reaching out! We saw your email and will reply soon. I’ve passed your feedback to our developer, and we’ll be working on the best possible solution.

Let us know if there’s anything else we can do for you.

Best,
The Univi Team 😊

text: Ich frage mich, ob die Menschen sich mit ihrer Mailadresse angemeldet haben - ohne die App vorher getestet zu haben? Die App könnte toll sein. Aber wenn ich mich direkt mit Mailadresse anmelden muss, um erstmal herauszufinden was die App überhaupt kann, verliere ich mein Interesse. Zumindest eine Testversion für 3 Tage wäre nett.
author: K Chin
developer_reply: Hi Chen, Thank you for your feedback! We’d like to kindly inform you that we offer a 7-day free trial to explore the app. If you have any questions, please reach out to us at contact@univi.app. We’d greatly appreciate it if you could consider updating your rating to 5 stars, as it helps us support more users. Thank you, Martyna Univi co-founder 💜

text: I love this app. It teaches strategies to overcome procrastination in small parts, so it don't overwhelms me with too much information.
author: Nicole Eichner (ZuckerZebra)
developer_reply: Thank you so much for your kind words! We’re thrilled to hear that you find our app helpful 💜 Breaking strategies into small, manageable parts is exactly what we aim for. If you have any suggestions feel free to reach out. And if you’re enjoying the app, please recommend us to your friends! Keep up the great work on your journey!💜

text: i started with this app and it seemes to be great
author: Elyan Faress
developer_reply: Thank you for starting your journey with our app! We’re so happy to hear that it seems great so far. Please don't hesitate to recommend us to your friends. We’re here with love and support as you continue to explore all the features. 💜

text: Hello i Like the App. But after the Update i cant anymore prioritize my Tasks. That was one of the Most important Things for me, because i cant prioritize Things in my head. That was in the Further App Version very helpful to sort the Tasks from up to down before i start with the Tasks. For understanding an example what happen: when i dont prioritize physically, i Clean at First the floor and than i Clean the table and than i have to Clean again the floor because all crumbs are on the floor.
author: miriam schröder
developer_reply: Hi Miriam, Thank you for your feedback. In the new version, there are some bugs we’re currently working on fixing, and we’re also gathering feedback on how to improve the planner. If you have more feedback or suggestions, feel free to write to us at contact@univi.app—we’d love to hear from you and make the app better for you. Take care! 💜

text: Kosten: 33 €/ Jahr mindestens, da ein Abo. 7 Tage Probezeitraum. ! Wann erfahre ich das? Nach dem Installieren UND nach dem Anmelden per e-Mail. Das ein gutes Produkt Geld kostet ist absolut richtig 😊👍 ☝️Aber das will ich VORHER wissen. Sonst erwarte ich eine kostenlos nutzbare Version (lite) mit kostenpflichtigen Extras. Stattdessen haben die Hersteller nun kostenlos meine e-Mail-Adresse kassiert.
author: Mago Familie
developer_reply:
Hi Mago, Thanks for your feedback! We apologize for any confusion about our subscription and trial period.
If you forgot to cancel the trial and were charged, please email us at contact@univi.app for a refund. If you enjoy the app, we’d appreciate an updated review it will help us grow! ☺️
Best, Martyna Univi founder and you ADHD friend 💜

text: Die Sprache lässt sich nicht auf deutsch ändern, es gibt nur Englisch. Somit für mich leider unbrauchbar.
author: Caroline Vybiral
developer_reply: Vielen Dank für Ihr Feedback. Als neue App unterstützen wir derzeit nur Englisch, aber wir planen, in Zukunft weitere Sprachen hinzuzufügen, einschließlich Deutsch. Wir würden es sehr schätzen, wenn Sie in der Zwischenzeit eine Aktualisierung Ihrer Bewertung in Betracht ziehen könnten, da Ihre Unterstützung für uns wertvoll ist. :) Alles Gute :)))

text: a helpful app with decent and useful features! I liked the personalised meditation but would also like to be able to choose between different voices and maybe even languages. I will continue using the app for now and completing the lessons there are so far, yet I am wondering when new ones will be added...
author: A. S.
developer_reply:
Hey Annika, we appreciate your suggestions about choosing different voices and languages. These are great ideas, and we’re working on incorporating them in future updates. We're also planning to add more lessons soon :) If you have any other suggestions, please write to us at contact@univi.app,
hugs, Martyna, Univi Co-founder and your ADHD friend

text: Süsse app und sehr Ablenkungsfreundlich gestaltet mit Animationen etc.
author: Gudrun Emmerich
developer_reply:
Dear Gudrun, Thank you for your lovely review! I'm so glad you find our app cute and distraction-friendly. If you have any suggestions or feedback, I'd love to hear from you! Feel free to reach out to me at martyna@univi.app.Have a wonderful day!
Martyna, Co-founder, Univi

text: One of the more exciting parts for me about the app was the time tracking of tasks... unfortunately it just doesn't work. Once I pass the estimated time, it goes directly into a break and when I try to skip it, it skips both the break and the next timer for work. If I keep trying it will skip everything until the next break. And then, if I tap on ending the task, it says it took me 0 minutes to do. I'd rather track my tasks on my own then.
author: PC M.
developer_reply:
I'm sorry the time tracking feature isn't working as expected. Please note that this feature is currently in beta and still under development. If you enjoy other features of the app, we would be grateful if you could consider updating your rating. Your support helps us continue to enhance Univi.
Reach out to us at contact@univi.app with suggestions

text: I like the KI created meditation. I alway wanted a more customised meditation in other mental health apps so I am very happy for Univi. But the quality of the voice is very blurry, that could be improved.
author: Tanja Schullerus
developer_reply:
Hi, Thanks for your feedback! We're happy to hear you enjoy the customized meditations. We're already working on improving the voice quality. If there's anything else we can do to make your experience even better, please let us know at contact@univi.app. ♥️
Best, Martyna, Univi Co-Founder and your ADHD Friend

text: Bin wirklich froh eine App gefunden zu haben, die mich in meinem Alltag unterstützt. Mit To-Do-Listen, Stimmungstracker sowie den KI generierten Meditationen, welche mir sehr helfen beim erneuten Fokus setzen. Bislang keinerlei Verbesserungsvorschläge, ausser dass es nur auf Englisch ist - für mich jedoch kein Problem.
author: Anastasia Koch
developer_reply: Hi! I'm Martyna Univi, one of the cofounders and your ADHD friend. Thanks so much for the lovely review! I'm thrilled to hear the app is helping you with to-do lists, mood trackers, and AI-generated meditations. If you have more suggestions write to us at contact@univi.app and please recommend Univi to your ADHD friends ♥️

text: Adhd dude here: This app literally changed my life. I did more in one week, then in 4 months together before. I don't have any laundry, dirty dishes and my apartment is organised and clean. I can't believe it, but it's simple and that amazing. Thanks to the developers 💕
author: Dario „Mr X“ Blaszczyk
developer_reply: Hey there! Martyna here, co-founder of Univi, and fellow ADHD friend. Your review absolutely made my day! It's incredible to hear how much of a difference Univi has made in your life. Your support means the world to us. Thanks a million for being part of our journey!

text: This is an amazing app ! I'm so happy and thankful that I've found it because I really believe, Univi can make a difference. I encourage everybody with ADHD to give it a try! I can't open the app anymore.WHY? 18.04.24: It's all fixed.Thank you , for the fast help !!!
author: Miriam Nawiesniak
developer_reply: Hi Miriam, thank you for this amazing, heartwarming comment. Can you please write us an email at contact@univi.app with the information of the email address that you used during the registration? Then, we will investigate this issue for you. We are happy to help.

text: Ich finde die App, wirklich super um mehr (auch unbekannte) Techniken und Methoden zum Umgang mit ADHS zu erlernen. Die meisten davon kannte ich schon, daher fand ich die App nur bedingt nützlich, aber gerade für Menschen mit einer neuen Diagnose ist sie höchstwahrscheinlich ein prima Werkzeug.
author: Sophie Struppellok
developer_reply: Hi Sophie :) Thanks for your feedback! We're glad the app provided some helpful insights, especially for those new to ADHD. If you have any suggestions for improvement, please share them with us at contact@univi.app. Wishing you the best on this journey! Martyna, co-founder of Univi and your ADHD friend

text: The tips and strategies are great. But is there a way to get them in written form instead of video? Especially when you are out of house without headphones or something. Maybe like Duolingo's "cannot listen right now" option.
author: Jaeger Monster
developer_reply:
Hi Jager, it's Martyna co-founder of Univi and your ADHD friend.
Thank you for your feedback about the written option! We'll definitely consider adding a feature like this :)
If you're happy with Univi we'd be grateful if you could update your review to 5 stars. It helps us a lot!
Have a wonderful day :)

Thanks again for helping us improve!

text: Ich finde die App bis jetzt sehr interessant und übersichtlich. Über eine deutsche Version würde ich mich freuen, dann könnte ich sie für /mit meinem Kind verwenden, denn das ist eigentlich von ADHS betroffen. es wäre auch hilfreich für ihn, diese App bereits in der Jugend zu verwenden, um bestimmte Dinge zu reflektieren.
author: Nicole Rohmann
developer_reply: Thank you for sharing your suggestion! We're currently focusing on enriching our content in English before exploring additional languages. More users and higher ratings increase our capability to expand, potentially including a German. If you find our app valuable, we’d appreciate a 5-star review to help us grow and reach more individuals with ADHD

text: Awesome App for my ADD! I'd love to See a Routine Bilder/Planner integrated in the Future to have IT all in one App 😊.
author: Jannik Speel
developer_reply: Jannik, we're thrilled you're enjoying Univi for your ADD! Your idea for integrating our routine builder/planner sounds intriguing. Could you clarify if by "Future" you mean the app at https://www.future.co/? Please answer at contact@univi.app to clarify this. Thank you for your input and for being a part of our growing ADD and ADHD community.

text: I hope you're app is one day in a german version. I've now saved the app on my Playstore wish list. Unfortunately my English is too bad to use the app effectively. Maybe one day Kind regards. :)
author: Diana Schust
developer_reply: Diana, it's Mateusz from Univi here. Thank you for adding us to your wishlist and for the kind words! We're currently focusing on expanding our content in English to ensure we provide the most value. We appreciate your patience and hope to cover more languages, including German, in the future. We're grateful for your understanding as we grow.

text: Super tolle, sehr hilfreich App. 👌👍💪
author: Angela B
developer_reply: Angela, it's Mateusz here, co-founder of Univi. Thrilled to see your review calling our app super great and helpful for ADHD management. Your encouragement drives us to further refine our features. Should you have any suggestions or need more support, feel free to reach out at contact@univi.app. Don't forget to tell your friends about the app.

text: Habe die App noch nicht lang, aber bis jetzt ist alles toll! Ich mag das Design und die verschiedenen Tools die praktisch und interessant für mich sind.
author: Lena
developer_reply: Hi Lena :) Thank you so much for your kind words. If you have any ideas on how we can improve Univi to help more people with ADHD, please share them with us at contact@univi.app :)

text: Pretty impressive for a beta App! Good and Clean design. The storytelling of the single parts is very immerse and i was flashed by the ai tutor and that he is actually responding to my answers! 🤯 Great Job! if you ever hire staff just contact me 😉
author: Roy Santomé
developer_reply: Roy, your enthusiasm is contagious! 🌟 We're thrilled to hear our AI tutor impressed you. We aim to offer top-notch AI-powered CBT tools, enhancing productivity and personal growth. Your feedback is invaluable as we refine and expand. Please send your CV to contact@univi.app. Who knows what the future holds? Let's stay connected! Mateusz from Univi

text: This app actually helps a lot. The learning sessions are quite entertaining and interactive. I particularly like the logging function and mood tracker.
author: Claudia Lütje
developer_reply: Claudia, it's wonderful to hear that Univi is significantly helping you with your ADHD! We're glad you find our learning sessions entertaining and interactive. Delighted to know the logging function and mood tracker are your favorites. If you have any suggestions on how we can improve future versions of Univi, drop us a line at contact@univi.app

text: Eine toll gestaltete App! Sie hat hilfreiche Tipps, danke dafür 😊
author: Katharina Nie
developer_reply: Katharina, we're so happy you find Univi beautifully designed and our tips helpful! Your kind words and appreciation mean a lot to us. Thank you for your 5-star review and for being part of the Univi community. 😊 If there is anything that we can do to make your experience even better, please drop us a line at contact@univi.app ❤️

text: Wow! Thank you sm for this great app!
author: N. K.
developer_reply: Thank you for your 5-star review! It helps us stay focused and motivated to work daily to improve Univi! Please tell your ADHD friends about the app, and if there is anything that we can help with, please drop us a line at contact@univi.app

text: bislang sehr vielversprechend
author: Stefanie Pech
developer_reply: Thank you very much for your review. We're very pleased that Univi is meeting your expectations. If you have any questions, doubts, or suggestions, please do not hesitate to contact us at contact@univi.app

text: This App is amazing for developing new habits and managing ADHD! There are different techniques which help through the daily /work /personal life as an ADHDer. The app shows different scenarios of daily struggles and teaches tools to solve those problems. The app is still under construction and will need sometime till it is fully set up. But it is already functional and very helpful.
author: Helena Heinen
developer_reply: Thank you for the wonderful review! We're so glad you're finding the app helpful. Please join our Discord channel to connect with our growing community and stay updated on app developments. Your feedback and engagement are invaluable to us: https://discord.gg/v4qmDZ6SRu
